data.title: Graph Neural Networks for Semiconductor Process Yield Prediction
data.abstract: We apply graph neural networks to multi-step semiconductor process data for early yield prediction. The model combines fab equipment graphs with ML feature stores suitable for edge gateways.

data.title: Transformer Models for Multispectral Crop Stress Detection
data.abstract: Vision transformers trained on multispectral drone imagery detect early crop stress under field conditions. We report transfer learning results for low-data farms and edge deployment budgets.

data.title: Neuromorphic Sensor Fusion for Smart Irrigation Controllers
data.abstract: Event-driven neuromorphic chips fuse soil moisture and weather streams for low-power irrigation control. We compare SNN and ANN calibrators on open field logs.
